headings.leadersBlurb: These four are the automatic AFC seeds. Everyone else is chasing the three wild cards.
headings.pathsBlurb: Win the AFC East, or be one of the three best remaining clubs in the conference. The closer route is the one that matters.

headings.conclusion: The New York Jets have been mathematically eliminated from the NFL playoffs.
